Seabass anonymized library export
==================================

Seabass version: 0.6 (beta)
Host OS: Linux
Hardware (as entered by the submitter): (none given)
Notes (as entered by the submitter): (none given)

rekordbox:
Tracks anonymized: 100
Distinct artists renamed: 52
Playlists/folders renamed: 4

Engine:
Tracks anonymized: 103
Playlists/folders renamed: 4

Dropped, because nothing in Seabass can anonymize them:
  exportLibrary.db-wal
  exportExt.pdb
  stm.db-journal
  stm.db
  sm.db
  hm.db-journal
  hm.db
  m.db.before-defects
They are missing from this export on purpose. Engine's play history
(hm.db) is one of them: real titles, artists and paths, plus which
set each track was played in.

What's included vs. stripped, on every track:
  KEPT as-is: format, file size, bitrate, duration, BPM, key,
    hot/memory cue positions and colors, rating, play count,
    last-played date, whether it's a streaming-service track,
    playlist membership/position, the low-resolution monochrome
    waveform preview actually used by this app, beatgrid.
  REPLACED with placeholder text (e.g. "Track 014"): title,
    artist, comment, cue comments, filename/file path,
    playlist/folder names.
  REPLACED inside the analysis files too: the file path each
    one embeds, which is where the artist, album and title
    would otherwise still be readable.
  ALSO INCLUDED: your player preference files (MYSETTING.DAT
    and friends). They hold settings like LCD brightness and
    jog feel, nothing about you or your music, and this app's
    Device Profile feature cannot be tested without them.
  ALSO SCRUBBED AND INCLUDED: your Device Library Plus
    database (exportLibrary.db), the mirror rekordbox keeps
    beside export.pdb. Its titles, artists, albums, genres,
    labels, playlist names, cue comments and file paths are
    replaced the same way, and the same real track gets the
    same placeholder in all three catalogs.
  REMOVED entirely: artwork images, the detailed color and
    scrolling waveform data rekordbox's own UI uses during
    playback (not read by this app), original file paths, and
    your My Tag vocabulary (exportExt.pdb), which has no
    anonymizer yet and so is left out rather than sent as it is.

Everything above is CHECKED, not just intended: this export was
read back through the app's own readers and every analysis file
was inspected before the zip was written. Had anything still
held real data, no file would have been produced.

Output size: 2.2 MB before compression (307 files).

Nothing has been sent anywhere; this only wrote a single zip
file. Review its contents, then attach that zip to an email to
sebas@kde.org if you'd like to help test against your
hardware/library. This dataset may be published as part of the
project's test suite. If there's anything in the hardware or
notes text above you'd rather not have published, leave it out
here and mention it directly in your email instead.
